name: Qoder
description: Qoder is an agentic IDE for real software development that transforms how AI understands codebases beyond snippets—grasping entire architecture including dependencies, patterns, and history. It enables natural chat for multi-file edits and task delegation to AI.
community_quotes: Currently no other solution is performing as good as QODER! I have done several A/B testings with Python and JS projects. Also in larger NextJS projects the overall outcome beats currently all others
Qoder makes daunting coding tasks manageable by breaking them into simpler parts. Its intuitive interface guides users through the coding process with helpful prompts
This tool is great, especially for learning codebases on GitHub. It gives me a clear understanding of the project architecture
